response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM circuit_counts), compared AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - average_share AS excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY excess_share DESC, circuitId LIMIT 10
